title: James River, Va. Deck and turret of U.S.S. Monitor LOC 5597835373
blurb: James River, Va. Deck and turret of U.S.S. Monitor Photo shows the light damage caused to the turret of the ironclad USS Monitor during her fight with the Confederate ironclad CSS Virginia, March 9, 1862 at the Battle of Hampton Roads-the first battle of two ironclad warships. Launched in January 1862, the Monitor was lost at sea in December that same year. Photograph relates to the Federal Navy, and seaborne expeditions against the Atlantic Coast of the Confederacy -- the Federal Navy, 1861-1865. Medium: 1 negative : glass, stereograph, wet collodion ; 4 x 10 in. Notes: Title from Milhollen and Mugridge. Corresponding print is in LOT 4182. Civil War photographs, 1861-1865 / compiled by Hirst D. Milhollen and Donald H. Mugridge, Washington, D.C. : Library of Congress, 1977.
